sentences.en: Juha travelled to the city for one day.
His wife said to him before he went out.

sentences.ar: היא אמרה: אל תעזוב אותה לרגע.
sentences.en: She said: do not leave it for a moment.
Juha said: good, I shall guard it.
He took the door out of its place.

sentences.ar: הוא שם אותה על הגב שלו.
sentences.en: He put it on his back.

sentences.ar: הוא הלך איתה כל הדרך לעיר.
sentences.en: He walked with it all the way to the city.
In the city everyone looked at him.
Children walked after him and laughed.

sentences.ar: הוא קנה מה שהוא צריך בשוק.
sentences.en: He bought what he needed at the market.

sentences.ar: הוא חזר הביתה בערב עם הדלת.
sentences.en: He came back home in the evening with the door.
At home everything was open and empty.
Thieves had taken all the things.
His wife sat and wept in the yard.
Juha said: I am not guilty.
He said: the door is with me, look.
